restoreInstructions: Download all 43 exact archive filenames below. Do not substitute old affected or intermediate copies.
Reuse Roadmark-VERIFY-SAFE-RECOVERY-20261014.py with this manifest. It checks archive hashes, restores in order into a new directory, and hashes the complete resulting file tree.
Use the new complete Toyota-integrated source only; historical source snapshots are not required. Retain all research and QA baselines and deltas in the listed order.
Five Toyota browser screenshots are deliberately omitted. Original file hashes and paths are recorded; reviewed text, table transcriptions, citations, URLs and approved packets are retained.
Historical support notes inside the restored files describe earlier checkpoints; this current index and manifest supersede their status and restore selection.
Reinstall dependencies from the source README/lockfile when needed. Current focused checks are not a full aggregate suite or production build pass.
